# Static Sites Instructions (site, site-en, site-maintenance, site-redirect)

## Overview

- **`site/`** — French landing page (alertegelee.fr). Plain HTML + vanilla JS + Bootstrap 5, bundled with Vite.
- **`site-en/`** — English landing page (frostalert.net). Mirrors `site/` with translated content.
- **`site-maintenance/`** — Maintenance placeholder page.
- **`site-redirect/`** — HTTP redirect page.

## Runtime & Tooling

- **Package manager:** npm
- **Build tool:** Vite 7 (`vite.config.js`)
- **CSS framework:** Bootstrap 5
- **Post-build:** PurgeCSS runs automatically via `npm run postbuild` — unused CSS is removed from output

## Project Structure (`site/` — same pattern for `site-en/`)

```
site/
├── index.html                      # Main landing page
├── sign-up.html / sign-up.js       # Subscription form
├── sign-up-complete.html / .js     # Post-subscription confirmation
├── check-subscription.html / .js   # Subscription check
├── unsubscribe.html / .js          # Unsubscribe flow
├── contact.html / .js              # Contact page
├── legal.html                      # Legal / GDPR notices
├── donate.html                     # Donation page
├── main.css / main.js              # Shared styles and scripts
├── asset/                          # Images and static assets
├── public/                         # Assets copied as-is by Vite
├── vite.config.js                  # Vite config
├── .env                            # Dev env vars (committed)
├── build-env-production.ps1        # CI script to generate .env.production
└── package.json
```

## Commands (run from the site directory, e.g. `cd site`)

```bash
npm install        # Always run first
npm run dev        # Dev server
npm run build      # vite build + automatic PurgeCSS postbuild -> dist/
npm run clean      # Remove dist/
```

**`postbuild` (PurgeCSS) runs automatically after `npm run build`.** Do not skip or bypass it.

## Key Differences: `site/` vs `site-en/`

- All user-visible text is in English in `site-en/`
- `lang="en"` in HTML `<html>` tag
- Form language field: `value="en"` (vs `value="fr"`)
- CNIL references replaced with GDPR references
- Contact domain reflects English branding

## Conventions

- No JavaScript framework — plain vanilla JS modules
- Environment variables (API endpoint URLs) are injected via `.env.production` generated by `build-env-production.ps1` in CI; use `.env` for local dev
- Keep French (`site/`) and English (`site-en/`) in sync for any structural or functionality changes
- `dist/` is gitignored; never commit build output
- Do not add npm dependencies without a documented reason
